findings.claim: 10-K 稱中國兩大集團控制幾乎全部中國精煉與濃縮配額，2025 年進一步集中；中國以外僅一家大型整合營運商（澳洲／馬來西亞），NdFeB 磁鐵亦由中國主導。
findings.excerpt: Outside of China, there are few producers operating at scale, with only one other major integrated operator across Australia and Malaysia. China also maintains a dominant position in the supply of NdFeB permanent magnets due to its vast rare earth reserves, advanced processing capabilities, and vertically integrated production infrastructure.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子明言新進入者可能透過併購、合作進入市場，且產業整併可能使對手具更強產品或定價彈性。
findings.excerpt: In addition, new entrants not currently considered competitors may enter our market through acquisitions, partnerships, or strategic relationships. We expect these trends to continue as demand for rare earth materials increases.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要未找到可量化的份額消長數據；USA Rare Earth（Stillwater 磁鐵、傳與 MP 有訴訟）、Lynas、Niron 等為相關對手/進入者線索，見 clues，未核原文。

clues.claim: USA Rare Earth 在奧克拉荷馬州 Stillwater 磁鐵廠調機，目標 2026 Q4 達 600 MT/年，為美國本土磁鐵直接新進入者。
clues.source: Motley Fool: MP Materials vs USA Rare Earth

clues.claim: 報導稱 Stillwater 磁鐵廠出現主要競爭對手。
clues.source: OK Energy Today: Major rival emerges for Stillwater rare earth magnet firm
